$comment: Models to compare for the Sonar / web_search_lookup pipeline.
All entries must be web-search-capable (live web grounding before
answering). Comparing across providers is the whole point — Perplexity's
Sonar family, OpenAI's search-preview variants, and Google's Gemini
grounded variants each have different MSRP-capture quirks.
Production default as of 2026-05-15 is openai/gpt-4o-search-preview
(swap from perplexity/sonar after the 2026-05-15 mega-sim showed 92% vs
50% MSRP capture). perplexity/sonar stays as the failover when
gpt-4o is rate-limited.
Models without web grounding (claude-haiku, gemini-flash without
search, etc) are NOT included here — they'd hallucinate URLs/prices.
Use the photo-identify harness (scripts/lottr-smoke/run.mjs) for those.
Rough pricing (fetched live at run start):
openai/gpt-4o-search-preview        — $2.50/M in, $10/M out
openai/gpt-4o-mini-search-preview   — $0.15/M in, $0.60/M out  (cheaper variant)
perplexity/sonar                    — $5/M in, $5/M out + $5/1K searches
perplexity/sonar-reasoning          — $1/M in, $5/M out  (newer)
perplexity/sonar-reasoning-pro      — $2/M in, $8/M out  (newer)
perplexity/sonar-pro                — $15/M in, $15/M out  (DROPPED — worse than vanilla)
perplexity/sonar-deep-research      — slower, deeper, more expensive
Add new models freely — the runner fetches pricing live and gracefully
skips unknown model IDs (logs a warning + cost=0).
